events.title: Exam Week Pressure
events.text: A major exam is coming up, and everyone around you is stressing about it.

choices.text: Study hard and stay disciplined
Blow off steam instead

events.title: Unexpected Bill
events.text: An unplanned expense lands in your lap and needs attention this year.

choices.text: Pay it now and move on
Delay it and hope it settles down

events.title: Tight Grocery Budget
events.text: You realize your weekly spending habits are quietly draining your cash.

choices.text: Plan meals and cut waste
Keep buying whatever feels convenient

events.title: Small Windfall
events.text: A small bit of unexpected money comes your way this year.

choices.text: Save it
Spend some on yourself

events.title: Extra Shift Available
events.text: There is extra paid work available if you are willing to stretch yourself.

choices.text: Take the extra work
Protect your free time

events.title: Study Group Invite
events.text: A few classmates want to start a regular study group, but joining means giving up some free time.

choices.text: Join and stay consistent
Keep your own pace instead

events.title: Weekend Side Hustle
events.text: A neighbor offers small weekend work that could help your cash, but it would eat into your downtime.

choices.text: Take the work
Protect your weekends

events.title: Bad Idea With Good Company
events.text: Friends are drifting toward something reckless, and saying no might make you look weak.

choices.text: Go along with it
Back out and hold your ground

events.title: Sleep Schedule Slide
events.text: Your sleep rhythm is drifting later and later, and the next few weeks could either reset you or drain you.

choices.text: Reset your routine now
Push through and deal with it later

events.title: Club Tryout Window
events.text: A school club is taking new people, and joining could change who you spend your time around.

choices.text: Put yourself forward
Stay invisible this time

events.title: Unexpected Recognition
events.text: Something you did gets noticed more than expected, and for once people are looking at you like you might become something.

choices.text: Lean into it
Keep your head down

events.title: Cost of Living Squeeze
events.text: Everything from food to transportation feels more expensive than it did last year.

choices.text: Cut back across the board
Absorb the higher cost and keep going

events.title: Night Out With Friends
events.text: Your friends want to go out, and joining them would cost more than a quiet night in.

choices.text: Go and make the memory
Stay in and save money

events.title: Routine Checkup Decision
events.text: You have the chance to schedule a routine checkup and get ahead of any issues.

choices.text: Book the appointment
Skip it this year

events.title: Performance Review
events.text: Your yearly review is here, and your recent effort is under a brighter light than usual.

choices.text: Push for more responsibility
Hold steady and protect your energy

events.title: Night Course Opportunity
events.text: A practical course could sharpen your future prospects, but it would cut into your time and budget.

choices.text: Enroll and stay disciplined
Skip it and keep your routine simple

events.title: A Strained Connection
events.text: Someone close to you feels neglected, and ignoring it would make the distance harder to undo.

choices.text: Make the time and repair it
Let the distance keep growing

events.title: A New Spark
events.text: A new connection feels promising, but building something real will cost attention and emotional energy.

choices.text: See where it goes
Keep your life simpler for now

events.title: Sleep Debt
events.text: A run of poor sleep is starting to catch up with your body and your patience.

choices.text: Reset your routine and recover
Power through it

events.title: Preventive Habit
events.text: A small daily health habit could help now, even though the payoff will feel slow and unspectacular.

choices.text: Commit to the habit
Stay with what is easy

events.title: Scholarship Window
events.text: A teacher points you toward a scholarship path that could ease the cost of staying on track.

choices.text: Push for it
Let it pass

events.title: Trade Program Pitch
events.text: A practical training program offers a steadier path than drifting through school without direction.

choices.text: Commit to the training path
Keep winging it

events.title: Roommate Conflict
events.text: Sharing space is saving money, but the tension at home is starting to leak into everything else.

choices.text: Swallow it and keep the cheaper rent
Move and protect your peace

events.title: Relocation Offer
events.text: A move to a different region could change your costs, schooling, and healthcare pressures all at once.

choices.text: Take the expensive coastal move
Choose the cheaper factory town

events.title: A Teacher Starts Taking You Seriously
events.text: Your consistency has become noticeable, and a teacher offers extra guidance that could compound over time.

choices.text: Lean into the structure
Take the compliment and keep your own pace

events.title: The Purchase That Felt Good for an Hour
events.text: A flashy purchase is right in front of you, and the emotional hit is arriving before the math does.

choices.text: Buy it and deal with the aftermath later
Walk away before it becomes a problem

events.title: A Connection Opens a Door
events.text: Someone you know offers to put your name in the right room, but only if you follow through.

choices.text: Show up prepared and make it count
Coast on charm and improvise

events.title: You Start Spiraling Before Anything Happens
events.text: Nothing catastrophic has happened, but your mind is treating the whole year like incoming damage.

choices.text: Build stricter routines around yourself
White-knuckle it and pretend you're fine

events.title: You Learn to Stretch a Bad Year
events.text: Pressure has become normal enough that you spot small survival moves other people miss.

choices.text: Strip life down to essentials and stabilize
Take on one more burden to stay afloat

events.title: A Club Tryout Opens Up
events.text: An activity is taking new people, and joining could change how visible and connected you feel at school.

choices.text: Try out and commit to showing up
Skip it and stay in the background

events.title: A Teacher Starts Investing in You
events.text: Your effort is getting hard to miss, and one teacher offers guidance that could compound if you let it.

choices.text: Take the guidance seriously
Keep things casual and don't overcommit

events.title: Your Group Starts Shifting Without You
events.text: The social map at school is moving, and doing nothing might leave you more isolated than you expected.

choices.text: Push yourself to stay in the mix
Withdraw and tell yourself it doesn't matter

events.title: Quick Cash Is On the Table
events.text: A small under-the-table hustle could put money in your pocket fast, but it will compete with the rest of your life.

choices.text: Take the money and absorb the strain
Pass and protect your time

events.title: The Week Starts Feeling Permanently Tired
events.text: Between pressure, screens, and everything else, sleep has stopped feeling automatic.

choices.text: Cut back and protect sleep
Push through and keep the pace

events.title: You Can Feel the House Budget in the Room
events.text: Money pressure at home is changing how school feels, even when nobody says it directly.

choices.text: Carry the worry quietly and keep functioning
Ask for structure and protect your footing

events.title: People Start Talking About You Like You Have Momentum
events.text: Being steady in more than one area is starting to compound into a real reputation.

choices.text: Lean into it and raise your standard
Enjoy the moment and keep things light

events.title: You Get Warned Before Things Fully Break
events.text: Someone notices your footing slipping and gives you one of those warnings that still leaves room to recover.

choices.text: Treat it like a real warning
Shrug it off and keep drifting

events.title: A Small Crowd Actually Pays Attention
events.text: A modest entertainment opportunity lands in front of you. It is not glamorous, but it could compound if you show up prepared.

choices.text: Over-prepare and treat it like it matters
Play it loose and conserve your energy

events.title: A Flash Of Attention That Does Not Fix Your Life
events.text: Something you did gets noticed more widely than usual, but attention and stability still are not the same thing.

choices.text: Convert the moment into paid work
Take the attention and protect your head

events.title: The Spotlight Stops Feeling Worth It
events.text: The work starts to feel more extractive than exciting, and people around you can tell you are running hot.

choices.text: Step back before you break
Push through and hope the feeling passes

events.title: An Easy Score Falls Into Reach
events.text: Someone brings you a job that sounds low-effort and high-return, which is usually how bad stories begin.

choices.text: Take the score and move fast
Keep the money smaller and the footprint lower

events.title: Someone Starts Talking Too Freely
events.text: A person near your orbit gets louder than you would like, and now your problem is not just the work but the story around it.

choices.text: Pay to calm it down
Do nothing and hope it burns out

events.title: The Crackdown Arrives
events.text: The pressure around your risky money becomes too visible to shrug off, and the fallout starts arriving all at once.

choices.text: Disappear, lose the income, and protect what is left
Stay in and try to bluff your way through it

events.title: The Future Stops Being Abstract
events.text: The relationship has matured enough that vague promises no longer feel honest. The question is no longer whether you care, but how much structure you are willing to put around it.

choices.text: Lean into commitment
Slow it down and keep talking

events.title: A Test Changes the Year
events.text: A private possibility becomes a concrete fact, and suddenly the year has a different horizon than it did a week ago.

choices.text: Get organized early
Try to pretend life is unchanged

events.title: Shared Space Reveals New Fault Lines
events.text: Living together turns little habits into a daily referendum on patience, money, and how much compromise each of you really meant.

choices.text: Talk through it before it hardens
Keep swallowing the irritation

events.title: The Baby Budget Is Not Theoretical Anymore
events.text: What looked manageable in rough math starts arriving as a steady stream of small costs, interrupted sleep, and constant recalculation.

choices.text: Cut harder elsewhere and absorb it
Spend for stability where you can

events.title: Recovery Lags Behind Responsibility
events.text: The world treats the crisis as over because the birth already happened, but your body and mind are still catching up to what was demanded of them.

choices.text: Ask for more help
Keep carrying it quietly

events.title: Nowhere to Sit
events.text: Lunch feels longer when every table looks full before you get there, and everybody seems to notice where you land.

choices.text: Slide toward someone familiar and make it less awkward
Eat fast, keep your head down, and disappear

events.title: A Rumor Starts Moving
events.text: Something small gets repeated enough times at school that it starts shaping how people look at you before you can explain it.

choices.text: Address it early and stay steady
Avoid people until it burns out

events.title: A Teacher Stays Late for You
events.text: One teacher notices you slipping and offers extra help after school without making a scene out of it.

choices.text: Take the help and show up
Say thanks and keep pretending it is fine

events.title: Tryout Window
events.text: A school activity is taking new people, and trying out could change how visible and connected you feel for the rest of the year.

choices.text: Show up even if it feels awkward
Talk yourself out of it

events.title: Cheap by Other People’s Standards
events.text: A school outing is called affordable by everyone else, but the cost still lands heavy on your side of life.

choices.text: Find the money and go anyway
Stay back and act like you did not care

events.title: The First Grade That Feels Real
events.text: A bad result lands hard enough that you cannot dismiss it as one unlucky week anymore.

choices.text: Ask how to recover before it gets worse
Act like it did not matter

events.title: Your Group Splits in Two
events.text: A fight inside your circle drags into school, and suddenly where you stand feels like a public decision.

choices.text: Pick a side and protect one bond
Stay neutral and absorb the weirdness

events.title: Someone Notices You Are Fading
events.text: An adult at school quietly checks in because you have become easier to miss than you should be.

choices.text: Take the opening and let them help
Brush it off and keep drifting

events.title: An Easy Way Back In Appears
events.text: A low-stakes chance to rejoin something after school opens up right when you were starting to drift too far from people.

choices.text: Take it and rebuild a rhythm
Let the chance pass

events.title: Your Name Gets Said Out Loud
events.text: A teacher or advisor publicly recognizes your effort, and for once attention at school feels like a door instead of a threat.

choices.text: Lean into it and stay visible
Acknowledge it and keep moving

events.title: An Adult Helps Kill the Story
events.text: A staff member offers to document what happened and cut the rumor off before it hardens into your identity.

choices.text: Let them intervene quietly
Handle it yourself online

events.title: Recommendation Window
events.text: A teacher tells you there is still time to convert your work into real opportunity if you are willing to ask for the recommendation directly.

choices.text: Ask for the recommendation and follow through
Tell yourself you will do it later

events.title: The House Wants Something Again
events.text: A repair lands with the familiar adult feeling that ownership is mostly a series of problems arriving in sequence.

choices.text: Fix it properly before it spreads
Patch it and buy time

events.title: Insurance Renewal Shock
events.text: A yearly insurance notice arrives and reminds you that keeping a stable life can still get more expensive without asking permission.

choices.text: Absorb it and tighten the budget
Raise the deductible and hope for a quiet year

events.title: You Hear Less Than You Used To
events.text: One of your children is still in your life, but more of what matters now seems to happen somewhere you are not included.

choices.text: Make intentional time even if it costs you
Keep telling yourself they know you care

events.title: You Two Are Not Reaching for the Same Life
events.text: A conversation makes it obvious that the two of you have been calling the future by the same name while meaning different things.

choices.text: Have the uncomfortable talk now
Keep the peace and postpone it

events.title: Your Body Stops Accepting the Old Deal
events.text: The routines that once felt survivable start producing consequences with less warning and slower recovery.

choices.text: Book care and change the routine
Push through like you always have

events.title: Recovery Wants a Whole Year
events.text: A doctor or your own body makes the same point: pretending this is a normal year will only make the next one worse.

choices.text: Scale life down long enough to recover
Treat recovery like weakness and keep pace

events.title: Your Area Gets Harder to Afford
events.text: Nothing about your life changed overnight, but the place around it did, and now ordinary stability costs more effort.

choices.text: Absorb the squeeze and stay put
Relocate before it gets worse

events.title: The Local Economy Turns Quiet
events.text: Openings dry up around you, and suddenly loyalty to the local routine feels more like a gamble than a plan.

choices.text: Stay patient and protect what you have
Start searching wider before you have to

events.title: The Job Still Works, But It Stopped Moving
events.text: You can feel the difference between stability and stagnation now, and the gap is starting to affect how you carry the rest of life.

choices.text: Invest in a reinvention path
Keep the paycheck and dull the feeling

events.title: You Notice How Much of Life Is Just Holding It Together
events.text: Nothing is on fire, but more of your energy goes into maintaining the structure than feeling present inside it.

choices.text: Clear space and protect something real
Keep functioning and call that enough
